aisha (ml-eng): quick heads-up — staging run of q6b 4-bit is hitting a regen loop on very short prompts (3-6 tokens). reproducer below, seen on two hosts

aisha (ml-eng): ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"q6b-4bit-v2","prompt":"OK","max_tokens":6,"batch_size":8}'
```

aisha (ml-eng): raw output: 
OK
OK
OK

 tom (infra): can you paste the full runtime flags / env? where is kv cache configured?

aisha (ml-eng): runtime flags: --batch=8 --seq=10 --kv-cache=on --prefix-cache=on
 logs show: "kvcache_entries: 2x expected for batch idx 0"

 leo (eng-ml): is this only with batching? try single request (batch=1) to narrow down

aisha (ml-eng): tried batch=1, still possible but way less frequent. with batch>4 it's reproducible within 10 requests

 maria (sre): any OOMs or node restarts? cpu/gpu spikes?
aisha (ml-eng): no OOMs; GPU utilization steady, memory stable. network latency normal

 tom (infra): quick try: disable prefix cache and rerun: REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=false
 leo (eng-ml): also try disable streaming, might be duplicate fragments causing concat regen

aisha (ml-eng): did both — freq dropped ~60% but not gone. attaching trace to ticket in a sec

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: model q6b-4bit-v2 -> q6b-fp16-v1 in staging (initiated by maria)

 tom (infra): opened INC-ML-5487 and added logs + traces: https://redwood.internal/inc/5487
 leo (eng-ml): sounds like a KV index duplication bug in the 4-bit kernels. pinging @dev-ml-kernel to triage

dev-ml-kernel: looking now — can you drop the exact trace id here? :mag:

aisha (ml-eng): trace id: trace-2026-03-12-0842, added small standalone repro harness to the ticket. also note this only appeared after q6b-4bit-v2 kernel bump

 tom (infra): temporary mitigation: keep fp16 variant pinned for staging and prod until kernel fix. marking P1 for rolling impact assessment

aisha (ml-eng): thanks — will follow up with a small diff reproducer and perf counters. assigning to dev-ml-kernel and eng-runtime for next steps :thumbsup:
